systems_under_test.e2b: real E2B cloud through upstream e2b SDK
systems_under_test.agentcore: real AgentCore Runtime through agentcore-e2b-sdk and adapter

shared_business_code:
with sandbox:
    result = sandbox.commands.run('printf context-ok', timeout=15)
scope: The application executes identical with-block business code. The application uses backend-specific observers and cleanup calls outside that block.

cleanup_semantics.e2b: The application calls kill again in finally, then checks is_running=False. A repeated kill return or exception is recorded separately; no_handle does not confirm termination.
cleanup_semantics.agentcore: The application uses an open handle to request Runtime stop and closes local handles. stop_request_accepted confirms request acceptance only, not observed termination or E2B kill semantics.

completion_semantics: completed/exit 0 means both observations and cleanup completed. It does not mean zero differences or full SDK compatibility. expected_behavior records each backend's separate lifecycle expectation.

observer.execution_subject: application using the original E2B handle

expected_behavior.description: E2B SDK exits the with-block by killing the cloud sandbox; the original handle reports is_running=False.

observer.execution_subject: application using the AgentCore client and reconnected handle

cleanup.action: AgentCore Runtime stop request (not E2B kill); local handles close

expected_behavior.description: AgentCore SDK exits the with-block by closing the local handle; the application reconnects the same Runtime session and executes a command.

summary.expected_lifecycle_difference: E2B __exit__ kills the remote sandbox; AgentCore __exit__ closes only the local handle.
